_comment: Minnesota 2026-2028 QAP, amended. The points are in the Self-Scoring Worksheet (MN_2026_2028.json); this file carries only what the worksheet leaves to the QAP: the tie breakers (Chapter 4.D, PDF p.56) and the 30-point floor for the RD/Small Projects set-aside (PDF p.54). The unacceptable practices schedule the worksheet cites (Chapter 2.J, PDF pp.21-24) is described in the worksheet criterion 7 note rather than coded again here. Page numbers are PDF page indices; the printed page number is eight lower in this part of the QAP (PDF p.56 is printed 48).

criteria.heading: Minimum 30 points for the RD/Small Projects set-aside
criteria.quote: This excludes projects funded through the RD/Small Projects set-aside, which must be eligible for no less than 30 points.
criteria.note: The worksheet (p.5) exempts this set-aside from the 80-point floor without stating a figure of its own; the QAP supplies it: 'This excludes projects funded through the RD/Small Projects set-aside, which must be eligible for no less than 30 points.'
